messages:
Anna (CS): Kicking off Gateway onboarding — stakeholders: Gateway IT (Sanjay), Product (Lina), Integrations (Mark). Draft success criteria and 8-week timeline below. @Sam (SE) @Maria (CSM) please ack.

Sam (SE): Ack. I'll own SDK + sample app. Need their SAML metadata and a test dataset by next Wed.

Maria (CSM): I'll run weekly 30m standups (Tues 11am PT). First enablement: platform walkthrough, then observability + cost controls.

Devon (PM): Proposed success criteria:
- prod inference running end-to-end by week 6
- p95 inference latency <= 250ms for 512 token seq
- baseline token cost <= $0.0012
- two positive customer-facing evals on prompt set

Alex (Ops): Note: Gateway asked for VPC + KMS. This adds onboarding lead time (security review) — flagged as medium renewal risk if not started this week :warning:. Recommend we open security intake immediately.

Anna (CS): Good call. Action items:
1) Sam: request SAML + test data (due Thu)
2) Alex: open security intake for VPC/KMS (due Fri)
3) Maria: send calendar invites + kickoff deck (due Tue)
4) Devon: prepare rollout plan + rollback criteria

Sam (SE): Pls confirm who on Gateway side owns SAML — I can loop them in. Also will add SDK quickstart PR to repo.

Anna (CS): Gateway contact is Sanjay (IT). I'll intro after we have intake ticket.

Onboard-Bot: Playbook created: /playbooks/gateway-onboarding. Checklist template attached.

Maria (CSM): I'll capture feedback after each enablement and add to shared doc. If we hit security blockers, propose a canary with hosted model while VPC completes.

Devon (PM): Timeline summary: week 0: kickoff + security intake; wk1-3: integration + tests; wk4-5: internal evals; wk6: prod launch; wk8: success review and renewal health check.

Anna (CS): +1. Let's reconvene Fri 10am PT to confirm security intake progress. If anyone can't make, drop status here. :thumbsup:
